title: The Fifth Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Colours and dyes: azure, lake and rosette; dyeing bone, wood, skins, leather and bristles; gilding parchment, the edges of books and iron; letters of gold and silver without gold or silver; inks for writing and printing; and varnish.
